_comment: Copy this file somewhere outside the repository, edit it, and point PRESENCE_WATCHLIST_PATH at it. It also works unedited: the two identifiers below are placeholders and match nothing, but the rules under them match live traffic straight away.
label: head of state transport

_comment: A rule watches a kind of flying rather than one airframe, so nothing has to be looked up first. role is one of tanker, isr, fighter, transport, rotorcraft, trainer. callsign_prefix matches the start of a callsign, which is a fleet rather than a single sortie. type is an ICAO type designator.
label: air-to-air refuelling

_comment: label says what an airframe is for — an office, a fleet, a job. Never a person: who is aboard is not a question this console answers. category is one of state, vip, other.
label: heavy-lift rotorcraft
